cards.card_text: What do the four men do to get the paralytic to Jesus?
cards.verse_text: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.

cards.card_text: The four men lower the paralytic on his mat through the roof.
cards.verse_text: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
